name: Linear OAuth App Registration and External User Access
summary: Register a Linear OAuth application, enable actor authorization, and validate external user access to project issues via OAuth tokens.
audience: Developers integrating with Linear on behalf of external users
managed: Check Composio managed auth for Linear, but confirm no official coverage yet

steps.title: Define OAuth Manifest
steps.body: Create a JSON/YAML manifest with oauth.client_name, oauth.client_uri, oauth.redirect_uris, oauth.grant_types, and webhook settings as per Linear spec.

steps.title: Submit Manifest for Registration
steps.body: Upload the manifest via Linear Developers portal or use the provided URL parameters to pre-populate the form. Verify all required fields are present.
steps.where: Linear Developers OAuth app creation interface

steps.title: Enable Actor Authorization
steps.body: Append `?actor=app` to the OAuth authorization URL so actions are performed as the app rather than the user.
steps.success: Token obtained with app actor scope

steps.title: Request User Consent
steps.body: Redirect external users to the Linear OAuth consent screen. Ensure the redirect_uri matches one in the manifest.
steps.success: Users grant scopes, app receives code

steps.title: Exchange Code for Tokens
steps.body: POST to Linear token endpoint with client credentials and grant_type=authorization_code to receive access and refresh tokens.

steps.title: Query Issues via GraphQL
steps.body: Use the GraphQL API with the access token to read project issues. Verify that the token can access the intended workspace and projects.
